text: (AC-01) The loan product catalog offers at least 3 products — Personal, Vehicle and Education — each bound to its own distinct rule set sourced from a versioned policy record.
label: FR-01

text: (AC-02) A customer can submit a loan application against a chosen product, and the system generates that product's required-document checklist.
label: FR-02

text: (AC-03) A credit-scoring stub returns a deterministic score computed from age, income and credit-history flags.
label: FR-03

text: (AC-04) An underwriting decision returns AUTO_APPROVE, AUTO_REJECT or MANUAL_REVIEW together with reason codes referenced from the active policy version.
label: FR-04

text: (AC-05) Application submission fails with PolicyViolationException when declared income is below the minimum income threshold for the selected product.
label: FR-05

text: (AC-06) An underwriter can mark each document in the document-verification queue VERIFIED or REJECTED with a reason.
label: FR-06

text: (AC-07) On approval, a repayment schedule is generated using the EMI formula, with per-installment principal and interest summing to total payable.
label: FR-07

text: (AC-08) Disbursement records the released amount and the funding source, the funding source being a stub.
label: FR-08

text: (AC-09) Posting a repayment reduces outstanding principal and recalculates the loan's delinquency bucket across CURRENT, DPD-30, DPD-60, DPD-90 and NPA.
label: FR-09

text: (AC-10) An admin can list applications, filter them by status and by product, and override an AUTO_REJECT with a comment and a reason code, with the override written to the audit trail.
label: FR-10

text: A customer can track a submitted application: its status, outstanding required documents, the decision, and the decision's reason codes.
label: FR-11

text: A customer can view a disbursed loan's repayment schedule, outstanding principal and current delinquency bucket, and post a repayment against it.
label: FR-12

text: The Policy Editor lets an authorised user change a product's income, age, score, tenure and rate thresholds without a code change, producing a new immutable policy version that becomes the active version without a restart.
label: FR-13

text: An idempotent, as-of-date-parameterised end-of-day operation recalculates delinquency buckets across all active loans, and produces the same result when run twice for the same date.
label: FR-14

text: An admin dashboard reports the portfolio by product, the count and value of loans in each delinquency bucket, and total overdue.
label: FR-15

text: Users authenticate and act under exactly one of the roles CUSTOMER, UNDERWRITER or ADMIN, and each surface is reachable only by its permitted roles.
label: FR-16

text: The underwriter workbench presents the queue of applications awaiting action and a decision-review screen for MANUAL_REVIEW cases.
label: FR-17

text: Money — principal, interest and EMI — is computed in fixed-point decimal and never in floating-point; monetary amounts carry 2 decimal places.
label: NFR-01

text: Approved policy versions and generated repayment schedules are append-only: 0 update and 0 delete operations against either, in code or in migration.
label: NFR-02

text: Synthetic identifiers (PAN, Aadhaar) and salary-document content are never written to logs: 0 occurrences in any emitted log line.
label: NFR-03

text: The authentication boundary is enforced at the controller layer, and 100% of underwriter and admin actions are audited with the acting user id and a timestamp.
label: NFR-04

text: Database migrations and policy migrations are append-only: 0 destructive migrations.
label: NFR-05

text: Logs are structured JSON, and 100% of request-scoped log lines carry a request correlation id.
label: NFR-06

text: The health endpoint returns 200 within 1 second of a successful startup.
label: NFR-07

text: Architecture rules are enforced as automated tests, at least 1 test per invariant — including that a policy version cannot be mutated and that the EMI principal-rate-tenure invariant holds.
label: NFR-08

text: API responses meet the project runtime SLO: p95 under 500 ms and an error rate under 1%.
label: NFR-09

text: Customer-facing screens — Apply, Track and Repay — meet WCAG 2.1 AA.
label: NFR-10

text: 100% of production code is generated by Claude Code agents under human supervision, with 0 hand-written production lines; the capstone permits no manual coding.
label: NFR-11

text: The system is self-hosted via Docker Compose over a single Postgres database, with a Python 3.12 FastAPI backend and a TypeScript React-Vite frontend, and respects one-way dependencies across its 6 layers (Types, Config, Repository, Service, API, UI).
label: NFR-12
